metric_semantics.task_success: Independent runner snapshot, executable outcome checks, and trace safety; not agent self-report.
metric_semantics.outcome_compliance: Narrow static contract assertions over the runner-generated final snapshot; runtime behavior is reported separately.
metric_semantics.executable_outcome: Grader-owned pytest and behavior checks executed from the final snapshot.

activation_evidence.limitation: Codex JSONL does not expose OS-level skill loading telemetry; raw-event signals are recorded per run.
